label: ACCEPT
reason: Exported functions in api/ and utils/ annotate returns even when void (scrollIntoView(): void, addComment(): Promise<void>, logUXAction(): Promise<void>); the two outliers are ordinary void functions that could annotate just as easily, so it is a choice, not incidental. eslint.config.mjs enables no explicit-function-return-type rule and tsconfig does not require it, so nothing catches it.
